📜 Transcript

Presenter: Look at the picture. Listen and look. There is one example.

Boy: Do you like my picture?

Woman: Yes, it’s fantastic!

Boy: Thanks – these are all my classmates.

Woman: That’s cool. Is that your friend Eva there – next to the helicopter?

Boy: Yes, that’s Eva. She’s taking a photo of it.

Presenter: Can you see the line? This is an example. Now you listen and draw lines.

1

Boy: Look, there’s my best friend Hugo.

Woman: Hugo … Where is he?

Boy: He’s looking at the big ship.

Woman: The boy who’s wearing shorts?

Boy: Yes, that’s right.

2

Woman: But look at that girl there. What’s she doing?

Boy: Do you mean the girl with the jellyfish on her T-shirt? That’s Pat.

Woman: But Pat’s going to sleep. That’s not good.

Boy: Yes. Well, she doesn’t really like old things, Mum.

Woman: But she can’t do that, can she?

3

Boy: Can you see my friend Matt?

Woman: No. Where is he?

Boy: He’s there. He’s wearing his new baseball cap. I think he looks cool.

Woman: So that’s Matt. But he’s riding the motorbike. Can he do that?

Boy: Yes! It’s great there, Mum. You can go on things.

Woman: Really?

4

Woman: Oh, look up there. There’s a girl in a plane.

Boy: Yes, her name’s Jill. She’s nice, but she says it’s scary up there.

Woman: Yes, but Jill looks happy. She’s waving at all the kids.

Boy: Yes.

5

Woman: That girl looks nice.

Boy: Which girl?

Woman: She’s wearing new boots. What’s her name?

Boy: Oh, that’s May. She’s OK.

Woman: She likes that poster of the girl on the skateboard.

Boy: Yes, she does.

🏆

Well done!
